svg.aria-label: adam siwiec. Seasoned Solution Architect. Software Engineer. Data & AI Expert. Entrepreneur. I build systems and software that help clients start, scale, and pivot with advanced AI/ML, contribute to open source, and mentor engineers in software engineering, AI/ML, and offensive security. FreeTech, Devrecated, OpenHat. Rust, Go, TypeScript, Python, TensorFlow, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Linux.
